hl_1_title: An IoT platform for hospital rooms
hl_1_text: ESP32 nodes in each room report temperature, humidity and service calls. A Rust API stores and serves the data, and a SvelteKit dashboard gives staff a live overview of every room.
hl_2_title: Built to ship almost no JavaScript
hl_2_text: SvelteKit with adapter-static prerenders every page to plain HTML, so nothing runs on a server and most pages ship zero client JS. Critical CSS is inlined, the fonts are self-hosted and subset, and Paraglide compiles the Danish and English strings at build time.
